## Slider

```{pyodide}
#| autorun: true
#| edit: false
import ipywidgets as widgets
slider = widgets.IntSlider(value=5, min=0, max=10, description='x:')
display(slider)
```

## Interact

```{pyodide}
#| autorun: true
#| edit: false
from ipywidgets import interact

def square(x=5):
    print(f"x = {x}, x² = {x**2}")

interact(square, x=(0, 10))
```

## Linked sliders

```{pyodide}
#| autorun: true
#| edit: false
import ipywidgets as widgets
a = widgets.IntSlider(description='a')
b = widgets.IntSlider(description='b')
widgets.link((a, 'value'), (b, 'value'))
display(widgets.VBox([a, b]))
```

## Output widget

```{pyodide}
#| autorun: true
#| edit: false
import ipywidgets as widgets
out = widgets.Output()
with out:
    print("captured output")
display(out)
```
